title: THE OBSERVER CARD (C4): the theory's observables live on the cut
claim_one_line: THE OBSERVER CARD (L174 C4, assembly): what an observer at the cut can measure -- c = 6 sigma (twice-derived), the tick clock (M then M^2 = RL), the seam multiplicities (3/5/2), the boundary-evaluated coupling (B1073), the edge hand (5-vs-6 at rho = alpha), the cut-only charge (1+8+9+8+1) and the geodesic record -- and what NO observer can, by theorem: the bulk charge (non-commutativity), the hand from bulk data (IDS-blind), values beyond structure (seven misses), sigma as a number (the unit; no uniform prior on scale); THE SYNTHESIS (composition, flagged): the observer card is the forced/free boundary read off physically -- forced = boundary-visible (QP-2 FLAT), free = boundary-ONLY (B1085), the observer IS the cut (the positive-monoid register restored as an interface); C1-C4 of the 3d completion BANKED, C5 fenced awaiting the owner-routed reading.
